title: Design system proposal for decisions 5–10 (play, capture, create, browse, store, accessibility)
summary: Propose the six open decisions in design/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md as mockups plus rationale so the Owner can lock them at the M0 checkpoint. Nothing is written into DESIGN_SYSTEM.md by this ticket; the Owner locks by AUTH (M0-OWNER-03).

acceptance_tests.test: design/proposals/M0-design-system-proposal.md covers decisions 5–10, each with the proposal, the Design Skills §3 rules it satisfies (by number), alternatives considered, and open questions for the Owner.

HTML mockups under design/proposals/mockups/ for: play HUD and controls (landscape), capture coaching (both modes), create-flow waiting states, browse cards and sort tabs, results and store screens; each rendered on the three test scans (bright room, dark room, cluttered tabletop). An iPhone Duo stand-mode variant of the play layout is an optional extra (design/proposals/iphone-duo-track.md).
Measured contrast ratios for every text and icon token on the three scans: text ≥ 4.5:1, icons ≥ 3:1; deuteranopia simulation attached for state colors.
Every glass surface has a flat variant; every animation has a Reduce Motion variant; touch targets annotated (≥ 44 pt / 48 dp; play controls ≥ 56).
The proposal is consistent with the binding constraints of decisions 1–4 and, once transcribed, with their locked text.
An AUTH REQUEST (design-change) 'lock decisions 5–10' is drafted in the proposal for the Foreman to file at checkpoint.
